actions.action: Confirm and freeze the exact selection
actions.mechanism: Separate visible-page selection from all-matching selection; confirmation freezes explicit IDs rather than a live filter.
actions.implementation: Provide keyboard-accessible “25 on this page” and “600 matching records” controls. Resolve IDs before confirmation; persist the confirmed count and scope.
actions.check: Change filters, pages, and matching records after confirmation; submitted IDs must remain within the frozen set. Test with a screen reader.
actions.risk: Label the frozen selection clearly when current filter results differ.

actions.action: Skip records changed since scope confirmation
actions.mechanism: Atomic version checks keep concurrent edits separate from the user's confirmed target status.
actions.implementation: Capture versions alongside confirmed IDs. Conditionally update each record against its captured version; return conflicts without overwriting newer edits.
actions.check: Modify a record between confirmation and write. Verify a conflict outcome, unchanged newer data, and an accessible explanation.
actions.risk: Requires backend conditional writes; client-side freshness checks alone cannot prevent races.

actions.action: Recover failures through a durable results ledger
actions.mechanism: Per-ID outcomes partition successes, failures, and unresolved requests so recovery excludes completed changes.
actions.implementation: Persist operation identity and outcomes. Reconcile uncertain requests through idempotency keys; offer keyboard-accessible retry of confirmed-set failures, with renewed confirmation for conflicts.
actions.check: Simulate mixed failures and a lost response. Recovery must neither repeat successful writes nor introduce IDs outside the confirmed set.
actions.risk: An uncertain response must not be treated as a definite failure.

actions.action: Explain and enforce reversal eligibility per record
actions.mechanism: Reversal requires both an unexpired ten-minute window and no subsequent record change, checked atomically.
actions.implementation: Store prior status, resulting version, and policy deadline per success. Show textual eligibility reasons; reverse eligible IDs using conditional writes.
actions.check: Test expiry, subsequent edits, and edits during reversal. Verify safe skips and screen-reader-readable reasons identifying each unavailable reversal.
actions.risk: Displayed eligibility can become stale; server checks remain authoritative.
